basket_L2.en: An oval basket with closed base, walls and an arched carrying handle. Continuous walls surround the cavity; both handle ends attach to opposite sides.
basket_L2.zh: 一个椭圆篮,底封闭,有篮壁和拱形提手。连续的篮壁环绕空腔;提手两端分别接在相对的两侧。

basket_L2.en: An oval basket with closed base, walls and an arched carrying handle. Walls run continuously around the cavity, and the two ends of the handle attach to opposite sides.
basket_L2.zh: 一个椭圆篮,底封闭,有篮壁和拱形提手。篮壁连续环绕空腔,提手两端接在相对两侧。

basket_L2.en: An oval basket with closed base, walls and an arched carrying handle. The cavity is enclosed by continuous walls; the handle joins the rim at two opposite sides.
basket_L2.zh: 一个椭圆篮,底封闭,有篮壁和拱形提手。空腔由连续篮壁围合;提手在相对的两侧与篮口相接。

basket_L2.en: An oval basket with closed base, walls and an arched carrying handle. Continuous walls close around the cavity while both ends of the arched handle fasten to opposite sides.
basket_L2.zh: 一个椭圆篮,底封闭,有篮壁和拱形提手。连续篮壁围住空腔,拱形提手的两端固定在相对两侧。

basket_L2.en: An oval basket with closed base, walls and an arched carrying handle. A continuous wall wraps the cavity; each handle end is fixed to the opposite rim.
basket_L2.zh: 一个椭圆篮,底封闭,有篮壁和拱形提手。一圈连续的篮壁包住空腔;提手每端固定在相对的篮口上。

basket_L2.en: An oval basket with closed base, walls and an arched carrying handle. Continuous walls surround the interior, with the handle attached at opposite points of the rim.
basket_L2.zh: 一个椭圆篮,底封闭,有篮壁和拱形提手。连续篮壁围绕内部,提手接在篮口相对的两点。

basket_L2.en: An oval basket with closed base, walls and an arched carrying handle. The cavity sits inside continuous walls; the handle's two ends connect to facing sides.
basket_L2.zh: 一个椭圆篮,底封闭,有篮壁和拱形提手。空腔位于连续篮壁之内;提手两端连到相对的两侧。

basket_L2.en: An oval basket with closed base, walls and an arched carrying handle. Walls stay continuous around the cavity and both handle ends attach on opposite sides.
basket_L2.zh: 一个椭圆篮,底封闭,有篮壁和拱形提手。篮壁保持连续并环绕空腔,提手两端附着于相对两侧。

basket_L2.en: An oval basket with closed base, walls and an arched carrying handle. Continuous walls enclose the cavity; the arched handle is anchored to two facing sides.
basket_L2.zh: 一个椭圆篮,底封闭,有篮壁和拱形提手。连续篮壁围出空腔;拱形提手锚定在相对两侧。

basket_L2.en: An oval basket with closed base, walls and an arched carrying handle. Round continuous walls bound the cavity, and the handle ends attach across from each other.
basket_L2.zh: 一个椭圆篮,底封闭,有篮壁和拱形提手。圆润的连续篮壁界定空腔,提手两端相对而接。

bench_L4.en: A rounded bench with an elongated seat and four supporting legs. A horizontal elongated seat rests on four separate legs beneath its ends. Rounded thick surfaces attach continuously to four separate downward legs. Overall width is 1.95 times depth; height is 0.22 times width. Parts follow functional positions.

bench_L4.en: A rounded bench with an elongated seat and four supporting legs. A horizontal elongated seat rests on four separate legs beneath its ends. mug_L3.en: An oval mug with open mouth and a pierced loop handle. Walls surround a sealed bottom cavity; upper and lower roots of the right loop handle join the cup. Oval continuous walls enclose the cavity; a thick rim and sealed base join those walls.
mug_L3.zh: 一个椭圆马克杯,杯口敞开,带穿环把手。杯壁围出一个封底的空腔;右侧穿环把手的上下两个根部与杯身相接。椭圆的连续篮壁围合空腔;厚篮沿与封闭底与该壁相接。

mug_L3.en: An oval mug with open mouth and a pierced loop handle. The walls enclose a sealed-bottom cavity, and the right loop handle joins the cup at its upper and lower roots. The oval continuous walls enclose the cavity, joined by a thick rim and sealed base.
mug_L3.zh: 一个椭圆马克杯,杯口敞开,带穿环把手。杯壁围出封底空腔,右侧环形把手以上下两个根部连到杯身。椭圆形连续篮壁围住空腔,并由厚篮沿和封闭底相连。

mug_L3.en: An oval mug with open mouth and a pierced loop handle. A sealed base sits beneath cavity walls; the right-hand loop handle joins the cup by its upper and lower roots. A thick rim and a sealed base connect the oval continuous walls that enclose the cavity.
mug_L3.zh: 一个椭圆马克杯,杯口敞开,带穿环把手。封底之上是杯壁围成的空腔;右侧环形把手通过上下根与杯身相连。厚篮沿与封闭底连接围住空腔的椭圆连续篮壁。

mug_L3.en: An oval mug with open mouth and a pierced loop handle. Walls form a cavity with a sealed bottom; the loop handle on the right attaches at two roots to the cup. Oval continuous walls bound the cavity; the thick rim and sealed base tie into them.
mug_L3.zh: 一个椭圆马克杯,杯口敞开,带穿环把手。杯壁构成底部封住的空腔;右侧环形把手以两个根部附着于杯身。椭圆连续篮壁界定空腔;厚篮沿和封闭底与之相接。

mug_L3.en: An oval mug with open mouth and a pierced loop handle. The cavity is walled and sealed below; upper and lower roots of the right loop handle connect to the cup. The cavity is enclosed by oval continuous walls, with a thick rim and sealed base joining them.
mug_L3.zh: 一个椭圆马克杯,杯口敞开,带穿环把手。空腔被杯壁围住、底部封闭;右侧环形把手的上下根部接入杯身。空腔由椭圆连续篮壁围合,厚篮沿与封闭底把壁连成一体。

mug_L3.en: An oval mug with open mouth and a pierced loop handle. Sealed at the bottom cavity walls stand, with the right loop handle's two roots joining the cup. Oval continuous walls surround the cavity and meet a thick rim and sealed base.
mug_L3.zh: 一个椭圆马克杯,杯口敞开,带穿环把手。底部封闭的空腔外有杯壁;右侧环形把手的两个根部连接杯身。椭圆连续篮壁环绕空腔,并与厚篮沿、封闭底相接。

mug_L3.en: An oval mug with open mouth and a pierced loop handle. Walls surround the cavity above a sealed bottom, and both roots of the right handle attach to the cup. Thick rim and sealed base join the oval continuous walls enclosing the cavity.
